messages:
Michelle: Hey folks — quick question while I finish up parental leave planning. When I come back onsite next month, what are the rules for booking the nursing/pumping room? Is there a priority system or recurring booking option? I’ll need ~30–40m blocks a few times a day.
Dana: Congrats, Michelle! :tada: Short answer: yes, nursing parents have booking priority. Policy summary: priority goes to employees actively breastfeeding or chestfeeding with infants under 12 months; we accommodate requests for up to 6 months after return on a case-by-case basis. For anything longer we do a quick case review.
Michelle: Thanks — good to know. Is recurring booking allowed (so I don’t have to rebook every week)? Any rules about how far out I can schedule?
Dana: You can request recurring reservations via the room booking portal. Recurring is allowed, typically for up to 8 weeks at a time; if you need an extension, ping us and we’ll renew based on demand. Also add a note like "nursing - name" on the booking so facilities can prioritize the room.
Arjun: FYI from an on-call/coverage perspective: we can rotate lightweight coverage for the 30–40m windows. Michelle, if you post your recurring slots I’ll draft a short coverage rota for the team so things don’t pile up.
Michelle: Awesome, appreciate that. One more: does Redwood subsidize pump rentals or reimburse pump-related expenses?
Dana: Yes — we offer a one-time pump subsidy through People Ops. Process: submit the receipt to Expenses > Create Expense and use expense code PARENT-PUMP (policy up to $200; see linked guidance). If you need an employer-provided pump while on site, we can arrange a short-term loaner from facilities pending availability.
Laura: Practical tip — when you create calendar events for pumping, set them to "private" and put the word `PUMP` or `NURSING` at the start of the title. Team knows it’s non-negotiable and it helps managers cover. Also add a brief status message so Slack pings are reduced.
Michelle: Great tips, thanks. If I submit the subsidy expense now (while still on leave), will that be processed before I’m back?
Dana: Yes — submit anytime. We’ll process it as a normal expense. If you want us to pre-book recurring room slots before your first day back, reply here with the week times and we’ll take care of it.
Michelle: Ok planning to request recurring 9:30am & 3:00pm M/W/F for the first 6 weeks — will post the times later today.
people-ops-bot: Your subsidy inquiry was logged (ticket #HR-2024-1187). People Operations will follow up within 2 business days.
Dana: Quick booking snippet for reference:```
Booking portal: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/rooms
Select room: "Lactation Suite 1"
Toggle: Recurring -> choose days/time -> add note "NURSING - Michelle"
Expense code: PARENT-PUMP
```
Michelle: Perfect, thanks everyone — feeling much more confident about the return plan :heart:
